title: SDP tables metadata schema

fields.name: file_name
fields.description: Relative path to the data file. Must not use ../.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Description of what each row represents.

fields.name: observation_unit
fields.description: Human-readable label for the observation unit, meaning the thing each row is about.

fields.name: observation_unit_iri
fields.description: IRI for the observation unit class.

fields.name: primary_key
fields.description: Comma-separated list of column names forming a primary key, with no spaces.

fields.name: protocol_iri
fields.description: IRI (DOI or stable URL) of the documented protocol governing this table's observation events. Start here: a protocol names the per-measurement methods, so the dataset does not repeat them.

fields.name: protocol_citation
fields.description: Citation for the protocol. For in-package protocols described in the package README.md, name the section here; protocol_iri may then be omitted.

fields.name: method_iri
fields.description: SOSA Procedure IRI when a single method applies to the whole table and there is no protocol document to cite. When the method varies per row, it belongs in the data as a coded column bound with sosa:usedProcedure.

sdp:rowRule: One row per table in the package.
